landing.heroSubtitle: Present without preparing slides: talk about your topic and Live Presentation AI builds the deck in real time, ready to show full screen.
landing.stepsSubtitle: Three steps and you are presenting.

s1.title: Set topic and audience
s1.text: Tell the studio what you will talk about and for whom: tone and design adapt.

s2.title: Speak
s2.text: Speak naturally. Live transcription turns your voice into text turn by turn.

s3.title: Present full screen
s3.text: Slides appear on their own on stage. Move through them with arrow keys or show them full screen.

landing.featuresSubtitle: What already works today in the live studio.

f1.title: Real-time transcription
f1.text: Your voice becomes text instantly, with partial captions as you speak.

f2.title: 21 automatic layouts
f2.text: The system picks the ideal design for each idea: titles, bullets, quotes, comparisons and more.

f3.title: Adaptive palettes
f3.text: Each presentation takes colors matching your topic, in light and dark mode.

f4.title: Off-topic filter
f4.text: Off-topic remarks never pollute your slides: they are filtered out without interrupting.

f5.title: Progressive images
f5.text: Slides appear first with text, then gain a generated image without blocking.

f6.title: All in your browser
f6.text: Microphone, stage and navigation live on the web: nothing to install, just speak.

landing.ctaTitle: Try it by speaking, not reading
landing.ctaText: Enter the studio, set your topic and start talking. Slides appear on their own.
landing.contactText: Want to use Live Presentation AI in your classes, talks or team? Write to us and we will tell you how to start.

t1.transcript: Today we talk about habits that sustain the team's energy…
t1.title: Team energy
t1.text: Three simple habits keep the pace without burning anyone out.

t2.transcript: First: real breaks, no screens, every ninety minutes…
t2.title: Real breaks
t2.text: Resting without screens restores focus for the next block.

t3.transcript: And to close: one clear idea per slide, nothing more…
t3.title: One idea per slide
t3.text: If everything matters, nothing is remembered. One idea, one slide.

example.note: Simulated Solar System demo, no microphone

transcripts.t1: Today we travel through the Solar System, our cosmic neighborhood…
transcripts.t2: The Sun holds almost all the mass: 99.86 percent of it…
transcripts.t3: The four planets closest to the Sun are small and rocky…
transcripts.t4: The outer planets, instead, are gas and ice giants…
transcripts.t5: It all started 4.6 billion years ago, with a cloud that collapsed…
transcripts.t6: And beyond Neptune there are dwarf planets and icy bodies…
transcripts.t7: Jupiter is so big that eleven Earths fit across its diameter…
transcripts.t8: And to close: of eight planets, only one has known life…
transcripts.t9: And here we are: Earth, our home, drifting next to the Moon…

faq.label: Frequently asked questions
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: The essentials before entering the studio.
faq.a1: A tool that builds your slides live as you speak: it transcribes your voice in real time and picks the ideal layout for each idea.
faq.q2: Do I need to install anything?
faq.a2: No. Everything runs in your browser: microphone, stage and controls live on the web.
faq.a3: The interface is available in Spanish and English, and you can present in your audience's language.
faq.q4: What happens if I go off-topic?
faq.a4: Off-topic remarks are filtered out and generate no slides, without interrupting your talk.
faq.a5: Yes, the live studio uses your microphone to transcribe. The demo on this page is simulated and records nothing.
faq.a6: You can try the live studio free for 24 hours after signing up. Write to us through the form if you want an extension.
